title: Holding my Grandson
synopsis: Old Lady Wang’s daughter-in-law has already lost two babies. Will her daughter-in-law’s third pregnancy give her the grandson that she’s always wanted.

fullText.simplified:
一直闹到晚上，总算见着了孩子的一点头发。产婆使出全身力气，除了把儿媳妇弄得越来越疼，没有任何帮助，孩子就是不出来。过了一个小时了，还是只见头发不见孩子。
    有人说，得上医院！
    上医院？王老太太不能这么办。她知道，上医院就是去开肚子，硬把孩子往外掏，不是自然产出来的！她们王家怎么可能这么做？王家要的是自然产下来的孙子，不要硬“掏”出来的。
    这点娘家妈也是同意的。那是啊，生小孩还能快了吗？小鸡生个蛋也得到了时候啊，怎么能硬往外掏呢？再说了，神婆作法还没有完呢，急什么？
    就这样，又过了一个小时，还是只见头发不见孩子，儿媳妇疼得连叫的力气都没有了。王老太太决定：保小孩不保大人！媳妇死了，可以再要一个，孩子更要紧。她现在没有力气，正好可以让产婆加大力气把孩子拉出来。如果媳妇死了，找个奶妈来养孩子，也一样好。
    于是，王老太太对产婆眨眨眼，说：“把孩子拉出来吧！”
    娘家妈可不干了，眼看着女儿的叫声越来越小，孙子算老几？女儿最重要！娘家妈说：“上医院吧！别等神婆作法了。谁知道她作的法是好还是坏？”说完，把神婆请走了。
    “不行！不能“掏”！”王老太太瞪着娘家妈就像瞪着仇人，就是不同意上医院。
    娘家妈不知道该怎么办了，毕竟女儿嫁给了王家，不是自己能决定的了。嫁出去的女儿泼出去的水，生是王家的人，死是王家的鬼啊！
    婆婆和娘家妈大眼瞪小眼，谁也不让谁。就这样，又过了半个小时，还是只见头发不见孩子。产婆见事不好，跑了！
    产婆一跑，王老太太有点慌了。娘家妈的话马上有用了很多：“产婆都跑了，不上医院还等什么呢？等小孩死在肚子里吗？”
     “小孩死在肚子里”打动了王老太太的心。可是，“掏”还是不行啊！
     “上医院去生小孩的人多了，不是个个都掏的啊。”娘家妈又说道，虽然她也不一定信自己的话。
    王老太太当然不信这个：上医院没有不掏的。
    正在这个时候，娘家爸爸也赶来了，他也觉得应该去医院。这下娘家妈更有底气了。
    唉！既然娘家爸爸也这样说，只能去了！不管怎么说，他到底是个男人。虽然生小孩是女人的事情，但在这种时候，男人的决定更有力一些。
    王老太太、娘家人、儿媳妇和只见得着头发的孙子，一起坐汽车上了医院。
fullText.traditional:
一直閙到晚上，總算見著了孩子的一點頭髮。產婆使出全身力氣，除了把兒媳婦弄得越來越疼，沒有任何幫助，孩子就是不出來。過了一個小時了，還是只見頭髮不見孩子。
    有人說，得上醫院！
    上醫院？王老太太不能這麼辦。她知道，上醫院就是去開肚子，硬把孩子往外掏，不是自然產出來的！她們王家怎麼可能這麼做？王家要的是自然產下來的孫子，不要硬“掏”出來的。
    這點娘家媽也是同意的。那是啊，生小孩還能快了嗎？小雞生個蛋也得到了時候啊，怎麼能硬往外掏呢？再說了，神婆作法還沒有完呢，急什麼？
    就這樣，又過了一個小時，還是只見頭髮不見孩子，兒媳婦疼得連叫的力氣都沒有了。王老太太決定：保小孩不保大人！媳婦死了，可以再要一個，孩子更要緊。她現在沒有力氣，正好可以讓產婆加大力氣把孩子拉出來。如果媳婦死了，找個奶媽來養孩子，也一樣好。
    於是，王老太太對產婆眨眨眼，說：“把孩子拉出來吧！”
    娘家媽可不幹了，眼看著女兒的叫聲越來越小，孫子算老幾？女兒最重要！娘家媽說：“上醫院吧！別等神婆作法了。誰知道她作的法是好還是壞？”說完，把神婆請走了。
    “不行！不能“掏”！”王老太太瞪著娘家媽就像瞪著仇人，就是不同意上醫院。
    娘家媽不知道該怎麼辦了，畢竟女兒嫁給了王家，不是自己能決定的了。嫁出去的女兒潑出去的水，生是王家的人，死是王家的鬼啊！
    婆婆和娘家媽大眼瞪小眼，誰也不讓誰。就這樣，又過了半個小時，還是只見頭髮不見孩子。產婆見事不好，跑了！
    產婆一跑，王老太太有點慌了。娘家媽的話馬上有用了很多：“產婆都跑了，不上醫院還等什麼呢？等小孩死在肚子裡嗎？”
     “小孩死在肚子裡”打動了王老太太的心。可是，“掏”還是不行啊！
     “上醫院去生小孩的人多了，不是個個都掏的啊。”娘家媽又說道，雖然她也不一定信自己的話。
    王老太太當然不信這個：上醫院沒有不掏的。
    正在這個時候，娘家爸爸也趕來了，他也覺得應該去醫院。這下娘家媽更有底氣了。
    唉！既然娘家爸爸也這樣說，只能去了！不管怎麼說，他到底是個男人。雖然生小孩是女人的事情，但在這種時候，男人的決定更有力一些。
    王老太太、娘家人、兒媳婦和只見得著頭髮的孫子，一起坐汽車上了醫院。

sentences.simplified: “小孩死在肚子里”打动了王老太太的心。可是，“掏”还是不行啊！
sentences.traditional: “小孩死在肚子裡”打動了王老太太的心。可是，“掏”還是不行啊！
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo hái sǐ zài dù zi lǐ dǎ dòng le wáng lǎo tài tai de xīn kě shì tāo hái shi bù xíng a
sentences.english: “The child to die in her belly” moved Old Wang’s heart. However, “scooping” was still out of the question!

sentences.simplified: “上医院去生小孩的人多了，不是个个都掏的啊。”
sentences.traditional: “上醫院去生小孩的人多了，不是個個都掏的啊。”
sentences.pinyin: shàng yī yuàn qù shēng xiǎo hái de rén duō le bú shì gè gè dōu tāo de a
sentences.english: “Many people go to the hospital to give birth, not everyone gets ‘scooped out’.”

sentences.simplified: 娘家妈又说道，虽然她也不一定信自己的话。
sentences.traditional: 娘家媽又說道，雖然她也不一定信自己的話。
sentences.pinyin: niáng jia mā yòu shuō dào suī rán tā yě bù yí dìng xìn zì jǐ de huà
sentences.english: The mother said, even though she didn’t entirely believe her own words.

sentences.simplified: 王老太太当然不信这个：上医院没有不掏的。
sentences.traditional: 王老太太當然不信這個：上醫院沒有不掏的。
sentences.pinyin: wáng lǎo tài tai dāng rán bú xìn zhè ge shàng yī yuàn méi yǒu bù tāo de
sentences.english: Of course, Old Lady Wang didn’t believe this, everyone who goes to the hospital gets “scooped out”.

sentences.simplified: 正在这个时候，娘家爸爸也赶来了，他也觉得应该去医院。
sentences.traditional: 正在這個時候，娘家爸爸也趕來了，他也覺得應該去醫院。
sentences.pinyin: zhèng zài zhè ge shí hou niáng jia bà ba yě gǎn lái le tā yě jué de yīng gāi qù yī yuàn
sentences.english: Just at this time, the daughter-in-law’s father also rushed in. He also thought that they ought to go to the hospital.

sentences.simplified: 这下娘家妈更有底气了。
sentences.traditional: 這下娘家媽更有底氣了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè xià niáng jia mā gèng yǒu dǐ qì le
sentences.english: At this point, the mother had even more confidence.

sentences.simplified: 唉！既然娘家爸爸也这样说，只能去了！不管怎么说，他到底是个男人。
sentences.traditional: 唉！既然娘家爸爸也這樣說，只能去了！不管怎麼說，他到底是個男人。
sentences.pinyin: ài jì rán niáng jia bà ba yě zhè yàng shuō zhǐ néng qù le bù guǎn zěn me shuō tā dào dǐ shì ge nán rén
sentences.english: Alas! Since her father also says so, we have no choice but to go! No matter what, when all is said and done he is a man.

sentences.simplified: 虽然生小孩是女人的事情，但在这种时候，男人的决定更有力一些。
sentences.traditional: 雖然生小孩是女人的事情，但在這種時候，男人的決定更有力一些。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán shēng xiǎo hái shì nǚ rén de shì qing dàn zài zhè zhǒng shí hou nán rén de jué dìng gèng yǒu lì yì xiē
sentences.english: Even though childbirth is a woman’s matter, in these kinds of times, a man’s decision is somewhat more powerful.

sentences.simplified: 王老太太、娘家人、儿媳妇和只见得着头发的孙子，
sentences.traditional: 王老太太、娘家人、兒媳婦和只見得著頭髮的孫子，
sentences.pinyin: wáng lǎo tài tai niáng jia rén ér xí fu hé zhǐ jiàn de zhe tóu fa de sūn zi
sentences.english: Old Lady Wang, the daughter-in-law’s own family members, the daughter-in-law, and the grandson whose hair only was visible, ..

sentences.simplified: 一起坐汽车上了医院。
sentences.traditional: 一起坐汽車上了醫院。
sentences.pinyin: yì qǐ zuò qì chē shàng le yī yuàn
sentences.english: .. got in a car together to go to the hospital.

sentence_translations: After struggling until the evening, at long last they saw a bit of the child’s hair.
The midwife exerted the strength of her entire body.
Apart from making the daughter-in-law’s pain worse, it was of no help. The child just wouldn’t come out.
One hour passed, and still they were only able to see hair and not the child.
Someone said, we must go to the hospital!
Go to the hospital? Old Lady Wang couldn’t do that.
She knew that going to the hospital meant cutting open the belly and forcefully scooping the child out, not a natural birth!
How could the Wang family do such a thing?
The Wang family wanted a naturally born grandson, not a forcefully “scooped out” one.
The daughter-in-law’s mother also agreed with this point.
Indeed, can childbirth be rushed?
We must wait for the right time for chickens to lay eggs. How can we forcefully scoop out a baby?
What’s more, the sorceress’ magic is still not complete. What’s the rush?
So just like this, another hour passed. Still, they only saw the hair and not the child.
The daughter-in-law was in so much pain she didn’t even have energy to cry out.
Old Lady Wang decided she would save the child and not save the adult!
If her daughter-in-law dies, she can get another one. The child is more important.
The daughter-in-law didn’t have any more strength.
It was now time for the midwife to increase her effort to pull the child out.
If her daughter-in-law dies, she can find a wet nurse to raise the child. That would be just as good.
As a result, Old Lady Wang winked at the midwife and said, “Pull the child out!”
The daughter-in-law’s mother however could not let that happen.
She looked on as her daughter’s cries became softer and softer.
So what about the grandson? My daughter is the most important!
The mother said, “Let’s go to the hospital!
Let’s not wait for the sorceress’ magic. Who knows if her magic is good or bad?”
After she said this, she sent the sorceress away.
“No! It mustn’t be ‘scooped out’!”
Old Lady Wang glared at the mother as if glaring at an enemy, not agreeing to go to the hospital.
The mother didn’t know what to do.
After all, her daughter had married into the Wang family. It wasn’t up to her to decide.
A daughter who has married out is like spilled water, ..
.. when she is alive she is member of the Wang family, and when she is dead she is a ghost of the Wang family!
The mother and mother-in-law glared at each other, neither yielding to the other.
In this way, another half-hour passed. Still, they could only see the hair and not the child.
Seeing that things were not going well, the midwife ran away!
As soon as the midwife ran away, Old Lady Wang became a little panicked.
The mother’s words suddenly became a lot more useful, ..
.. “The midwife has run away. If we don’t go to the hospital, what are we waiting for?
.. Waiting for the child to die in her belly?”
“The child to die in her belly” moved Old Wang’s heart. However, “scooping” was still out of the question!
“Many people go to the hospital to give birth, not everyone gets ‘scooped out’.”
The mother said, even though she didn’t entirely believe her own words.
Of course, Old Lady Wang didn’t believe this, everyone who goes to the hospital gets “scooped out”.
Just at this time, the daughter-in-law’s father also rushed in. He also thought that they ought to go to the hospital.
At this point, the mother had even more confidence.
Alas! Since her father also says so, we have no choice but to go! No matter what, when all is said and done he is a man.
Even though childbirth is a woman’s matter, in these kinds of times, a man’s decision is somewhat more powerful.
Old Lady Wang, the daughter-in-law’s own family members, the daughter-in-law, and the grandson whose hair only was visible, ..
.. got in a car together to go to the hospital.
